# Friction-Killer Suite

> 13 zero-subscription, 100% local-first Web Apps & offline Python CLIs for European/B2B finance, e-invoicing, bank-feed conversion, e-commerce migration, and developer workflows. All data runs locally in browser memory or offline CLI with zero server uploads.

## Active Products
- [LinearBridge](https://domstijn.github.io/friction-killer-suite/products/notion-linear-prd-sync/) (€29 once): Chrome MV3 extension injecting a 'Push PRD to Linear' action bar inside Notion that decomposes headings/checklists into Linear parent + sub-issues and syncs status badges locally via user API keys.
- [NotionGitExport](https://domstijn.github.io/friction-killer-suite/products/notion-clean-md-exporter/) (€24 once): Zero-dependency CLI wrapper that strips UUID suffixes, converts database properties into clean YAML frontmatter, rewrites relative links, and localizes assets for Git/Obsidian/Astro.
- [ExtProfileLock](https://domstijn.github.io/friction-killer-suite/products/vscode-workspace-profile-config/) (€19 once): VS Code extension that reads a repo-committed workspace-lock.json + .env to auto-toggle conflicting extensions and refresh extension host env vars without restarting.
- [ClaudeProfileSwitch](https://domstijn.github.io/friction-killer-suite/products/claude-profile-switcher/) (€24 once): Zero-dependency CLI that snapshots/swaps isolated Claude auth + MCP profiles per repo (.claude-profile) and audits local JSONL session token burn against 5-hour quota windows
- [NotionGuestBridge](https://domstijn.github.io/friction-killer-suite/products/notion-guest-mcp-bridge/) (€29 once): Chrome MV3 extension operating on the guest's open Notion tab to extract database tables, callouts & nested pages into structured JSON/Markdown MCP context packs with zero Member seat upgrade or cookie theft
- [WebflowAssetZip](https://domstijn.github.io/friction-killer-suite/products/webflow-cms-asset-migrator/) (€29 once): Chrome MV3 extension that parses Webflow CMS CSVs or open CMS collections, downloads and renames every image/asset by item slug, rewrites CSV + Rich-Text HTML CDN URLs to your new host (Framer/S3/R2/WP), and outputs a 301-redirects.csv map.
- [StripePayoutBridge](https://domstijn.github.io/friction-killer-suite/products/stripe-payout-xero-qbo-splitter/) (€29 once): 100% local in-browser Web App (+ CLI) that parses Stripe/PayPal itemized payout CSVs, groups transactions by payout batch into balanced double-entry clearing account journals (Gross Sales by tax rate, Processing Fees, Refunds/Disputes, FX fees, Net Transfer), and exports Xero Manual Journal CSV, QuickBooks Journal CSV, and DATEV Buchungsstapel CSV.
- [LemonExitBridge](https://domstijn.github.io/friction-killer-suite/products/lemonsqueezy-stripe-polar-migrator/) (€29 once): 100% local in-browser Web App (+ Python CLI .whl) that joins exported Lemon Squeezy Orders, Subscriptions, and License Keys CSVs, isolates at-risk PayPal MRR vs. transferable Card subscribers, calculates exact Unix trial_end timestamps so re-subscribing customers are never double-charged, and exports Stripe Billing / Polar migration CSVs plus a drop-in Legacy License Key JSON/Worker bundle.
- [OssVatBridge](https://domstijn.github.io/friction-killer-suite/products/eu-oss-vat-return-compiler/) (€29 once): 100% browser-local Web App (+ Python CLI) that merges Stripe Tax, Shopify, and Lemon Squeezy CSVs, normalizes currencies via ECB quarterly rates, aggregates EU27 Member-State VAT by Standard/Reduced rate, and exports Germany BZSt/BOP semicolon CSV, Ireland ROS XML, and EU27 OSS audit ledgers.
- [AmzSettlementBridge](https://domstijn.github.io/friction-killer-suite/products/amazon-settlement-xero-qbo-splitter/) (€29 once): 100% browser-local Web App (+ Python CLI) that parses Amazon Seller Central Flat-File V2 (.txt/.tsv) settlements locally, separates Principal sales, Marketplace Facilitator tax, FBA/referral/storage/PPC fees, refunds, and rolling reserves into integer-cent balanced Xero, QuickBooks, and DATEV clearing journals.
- [EInvoiceLocal](https://domstijn.github.io/friction-killer-suite/products/e-invoice-xml-batch-converter/) (€29 once): 100% browser-local Web App (+ Python CLI) that validates EN 16931 math rules across UBL 2.1 and UN/CEFACT CII XML invoices, renders printable A4 invoice views, and batch-exports unified DATEV EXTF_Buchungsstapel.csv (with BU-Schlüssel tax keys), Xero Bills CSV, and QuickBooks CSV.
- [ShopMetaShift](https://domstijn.github.io/friction-killer-suite/products/woo-shopify-metafield-migrator/) (€29 once): 100% local in-browser Web App (+ CLI) that transforms WooCommerce variable/variation CSV exports into valid Shopify Admin & Matrixify-ready multi-row CSVs with typed 'Variant Metafield: custom.key [type]' columns, >3 option overflow mapping, and 301 redirect rules.
- [BankFeedBridge](https://domstijn.github.io/friction-killer-suite/products/camt053-mt940-qbo-xero-converter/) (€29 once): 100% browser-local Web App (+ Python CLI) that parses multi-account ISO 20022 camt.053 XML and MT940 statements locally, flattens nested TxDtls SEPA batches, reconciles opening/closing balances in integer cents, and exports QuickBooks Web Connect (.qbo with INTU.BID selector), Xero (.ofx / CSV), and DATEV bank CSVs.

## 20 Technical Troubleshooting & Format Conversion Guides
- [How to Fix QuickBooks Error OL-222 for CAMT.053 & MT940 Bank Files](https://domstijn.github.io/friction-killer-suite/guides/quickbooks-error-ol-222-camt053-fix/): Why QuickBooks Desktop rejects converted bank files with Error OL-222 / OL-221: missing <INTU.BID>, invalid <CURDEF>, unescaped XML & duplicate <FITID>. Fix locally in Chrome.
- [Convert ISO 20022 CAMT.053.001.02 / .08 XML to QuickBooks .QBO Locally](https://domstijn.github.io/friction-killer-suite/guides/camt053-to-quickbooks-qbo-converter/): Step-by-step guide to converting EU ISO 20022 CAMT.053 bank statements into QuickBooks Web Connect (.qbo) in Chrome with zero bank file uploads.
- [Convert SWIFT MT940 (.sta / .940) Files into Clean Xero OFX & CSV Statements](https://domstijn.github.io/friction-killer-suite/guides/mt940-sta-to-xero-ofx-csv/): Parse SWIFT MT940 :60F:, :61:, :86: structured subfields (?20..?33), RD/RC reversals, and :62F: closing balances into clean Xero OFX and CSV files locally.
- [Convert Dutch Bank CAMT.053 & MT940 (ING, Rabobank, ABN AMRO) to Xero & QuickBooks](https://domstijn.github.io/friction-killer-suite/guides/ing-rabobank-abn-amro-camt053-xero-qbo/): Handle ING, Rabobank, bunq, and ABN AMRO CAMT.053 XML or MT940 statements in Xero and QuickBooks Desktop/Online without losing SEPA batch details.
- [Sparkasse & Volksbank CAMT.053 / MT940 lokal nach DATEV CSV & Xero konvertieren](https://domstijn.github.io/friction-killer-suite/guides/sparkasse-volksbank-camt053-datev-csv/): ISO 20022 CAMT.053.001.02/.08 und MT940 von Sparkasse, VR-Bank, Deutsche Bank & Commerzbank lokal im Browser in saubere DATEV-CSV, .QBO oder Xero OFX umwandeln.
- [Zero-Subscription Alternative to ProperSoft Bank2QBO (€29 Once vs. $19.99–$49/mo)](https://domstijn.github.io/friction-killer-suite/guides/propersoft-bank2qbo-alternative-local/): Why firms switch from recurring ProperSoft / MoneyThumb subscriptions to a €29 one-time browser-local CAMT.053 & MT940 to QBO/OFX/Xero/DATEV converter.
- [How to Unwrap Nested CAMT.053 <NtryDtls><TxDtls> Batches Without Cent Drift](https://domstijn.github.io/friction-killer-suite/guides/sepa-batch-ntrydtls-txdtls-reconciliation/): Technical guide to flattening ISO 20022 CAMT.053 SEPA batch entries (<NtryDtls>/<TxDtls>) while asserting OPBD + delta = CLBD in exact integer cents.
- [XRechnung XML einfach lesen, als A4-PDF drucken & DATEV EXTF exportieren](https://domstijn.github.io/friction-killer-suite/guides/xrechnung-xml-zu-pdf-und-datev-extf/): Reine XRechnung-XML-Dateien (ohne PDF-Hülle) lokal in Chrome als saubere A4-Rechnung drucken, EN 16931 Summen prüfen und als DATEV EXTF Buchungsstapel exportieren.
- [Debugging EN 16931 BR-CO-10 & BR-CO-15 Tax Calculation Errors in XRechnung & Peppol XML](https://domstijn.github.io/friction-killer-suite/guides/en16931-br-co-10-br-co-15-validation-errors/): Understand and verify EN 16931 math rules BR-CO-10 (LineNetTotal vs LegalMonetaryTotal) and BR-CO-15 (Net + VAT = Gross) across UBL 2.1 and CII XML.
- [DATEV BU-Schlüssel & SKR03-Konten aus ZUGFeRD & XRechnung XML bestimmen](https://domstijn.github.io/friction-killer-suite/guides/zugferd-xml-datev-bu-schluessel-mapping/): Wie BT-118 / BT-151 Umsatzsteuer-Kategorien (S, AE, Z, E) aus ZUGFeRD CII und XRechnung UBL deterministisch auf DATEV BU-Schlüssel 9, 8, 94 und 0 gemappt werden.
- [Convert Peppol BIS 3.0 UBL XML Files into Readable PDFs & Xero/QuickBooks Bills CSV](https://domstijn.github.io/friction-killer-suite/guides/peppol-bis-3-xml-to-pdf-xero-csv/): Read incoming Belgian, German, and EU Peppol BIS Billing 3.0 XML invoices locally in Chrome, print A4 copies, and export Xero Bills or QuickBooks Bills CSV.
- [Zero-Install Browser Alternative When Quba Viewer Crashes (libjcef / LC_ALL / Locale Bugs)](https://domstijn.github.io/friction-killer-suite/guides/quba-viewer-alternative-browser-einvoice/): Avoid JCEF locale SIGSEGV crashes and heavy desktop installers: view, validate EN 16931, print A4 PDFs, and export DATEV EXTF right inside Chrome.
- [How to Fix BZSt Mein BOP OSS CSV Import Errors ('GR' vs 'EL', Semicolon Delimiter & Refunds)](https://domstijn.github.io/friction-killer-suite/guides/bzst-oss-csv-gr-el-greece-error-fix/): Solve German BZSt Mein BOP EU-OSS CSV upload rejections caused by ISO country code GR (Greece -> EL), comma vs semicolon delimiters, B2B rows, and refunds.
- [Combine Stripe Tax, Shopify & Lemon Squeezy Sales into One Quarterly EU OSS Return](https://domstijn.github.io/friction-killer-suite/guides/stripe-tax-shopify-eu-oss-vat-return/): Stop maintaining fragile VLOOKUP Excel sheets every quarter: merge multi-platform EU B2C CSV exports locally into BZSt BOP CSV & Ireland ROS XML.
- [How to Generate Validated Ireland ROS EU VAT OSS XML Without Manual Portal Entry](https://domstijn.github.io/friction-killer-suite/guides/ireland-ros-eu-oss-xml-generator/): Compile multi-country Stripe Tax & Shopify sales CSVs into structured EU VAT OSS member-state buckets and ROS XML locally in Chrome.
- [Migrating Off Lemon Squeezy Before March 31, 2027: PayPal Cohort Split & Stripe trial_end Unix](https://domstijn.github.io/friction-killer-suite/guides/lemon-squeezy-shutdown-paypal-stripe-migration/): Why Lemon Squeezy PayPal subscriptions cannot auto-migrate to Stripe/Polar without buyer re-auth—and how to audit MRR-at-risk and compute exact trial_end Unix timestamps.
- [How to Keep Existing Lemon Squeezy License Keys Working After Migrating to Stripe / Polar](https://domstijn.github.io/friction-killer-suite/guides/lemon-squeezy-to-polar-legacy-license-keys/): Stop breaking existing paid users' desktop apps and CLI licenses during your Lemon Squeezy migration: export a deterministic legacy-keys.json lookup map.
- [Migrate WooCommerce CSVs to Shopify / Matrixify Without Orphaning Variants or Dropping Attributes 4+](https://domstijn.github.io/friction-killer-suite/guides/woocommerce-to-shopify-metafields-matrixify-csv/): Native Shopify CSV breaks on WooCommerce variable children, >3 product attributes, Yoast SEO metadata, GTINs, and old URLs. Convert locally in Chrome.
- [Split Amazon Settlement Report V2 (.TSV/.TXT) Into Xero & QuickBooks Deposit Journals](https://domstijn.github.io/friction-killer-suite/guides/amazon-settlement-report-v2-xero-quickbooks/): Why recording raw Amazon bank deposits distorts P&L revenue and VAT: unpack Gross Sales, FBA Fees, Refunds, Promos & Reserves into balanced zero-diff journals locally.
- [Split Net Stripe Bank Deposits Back into Gross Revenue, Fees & Refunds Locally](https://domstijn.github.io/friction-killer-suite/guides/stripe-payout-reconciliation-xero-quickbooks/): Stop letting Stripe Payouts lump net deposits into bank feeds: split Stripe Balance History CSVs into Gross Sales, Stripe Fees, Refunds & Disputes for Xero/QBO.

## Privacy & Verification Architecture
- Browser Web Apps use native `DOMParser` and JavaScript `File.text()` inside the browser tab with zero uploaded XML/CSV payloads.
- Air-gapped `.whl` Python CLIs run locally offline (`camt053-mt940-qbo-xero-converter`, `e-invoice-xml-batch-converter`, `eu-oss-vat-return-compiler`, `lemonsqueezy-stripe-polar-migrator`, `amazon-settlement-xero-qbo-splitter`, `stripe-payout-xero-qbo-splitter`, `woo-shopify-metafield-migrator`, `notion-clean-md-exporter`, `claude-profile-switch`).
